title: Anchoring Clinical Events in Time: UID-Preserving Multimodal Reconstruction and Source-Grounded Adjudication
abstract: arXiv:2609.13062v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Interpreting a patient's hospital course depends on when symptoms developed, tests were performed, and treatments began. Discharge summaries often leave this chronology unclear, while structured electronic health record (EHR) tables timestamp only some of these events. We reconstruct clinical timelines by retrieving structured evidence for narrative events and jointly revising their estimated times. Each extracted occurrence carries a persistent unique identifier (UID) linked to its source span, keeping repeated mentions distinct throughout reconstruction. We also introduce GAVEL, a large language model (LLM) judge that checks disagreements between two timelines against the note and structured record and cites evidence for its verdicts. We evaluated six open-weight models on 40 clinician-annotated discharge summaries. Our pipeline recovered more reference events than LLM-Timeline and TKW2 when each comparison used the same backbone.

translated_title: 将临床事件锚定于时间：保留UID的多模态重建与基于证据来源的裁定
translated_abstract: 解读患者的住院病程取决于症状何时出现、检查何时进行以及治疗何时开始。出院小结往往使这一时间顺序不清晰，而结构化电子健康记录（EHR）表格仅对其中部分事件标注了时间戳。我们通过为叙事文本中的事件检索结构化证据并联合修正其估计时间来重建临床时间线。每个提取出的事件都携带一个与其来源片段关联的持久唯一标识符（UID），从而在整个重建过程中保持重复提及的事件相互区分。我们还提出了GAVEL，一个大语言模型（LLM）裁判，它依据病历文本和结构化记录核查两条时间线之间的分歧，并为其裁定结果引用证据。我们在40份由临床医生标注的出院小结上评估了六个开放权重模型。当每次对比使用相同的骨干模型时，我们的流水线比LLM-Timeline和TKW2恢复出更多的参考事件。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种保留唯一标识符（UID）的多模态临床时间线重建方法，并结合基于证据引用的LLM裁判GAVEL，从出院小结和EHR中更准确地对齐、校准和裁定临床事件的时间。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes UID-preserving multimodal timeline reconstruction combined with GAVEL, an evidence-grounded LLM judge, to more accurately align, calibrate, and adjudicate the timing of clinical events from discharge summaries and EHR data.
